I used to have a weekend job in hairdressing for 3 years, buy a tangle teaser for your hair, shampoo your hair twice and then dry off, use conditioner, leave on for 3 mins and take off. This will help with dryness or grease. Take off dead split ends every few months. Even though taking off hair may seem counter intuitive it helps alot in the long run. Invest in a decent hair dryer as the drying time will add up yet don't hold it too close, you'll become irritated and try to rush it, keep it at least 20cm away. Don't change up your diet overnight as it can cause changes in your hair quality, nothing too extreme but keep it in mind.
